title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.20434v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The coordination of multi-scale tasks is an effective strategy for computational materials discovery, yet the repeated application of diverse algorithms and tools renders it challenging. We report MAESTRO, a large language model (LLM) agent system capable of executing the entire screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). It processes a large body of MOF literature, links relevant publications to their crystal structures, and curates the results into a computation-ready database, which is then screened through a strategy of progressively increasing computational cost. The promising candidates identified for separation under wet flue gas conditions all originate from unrelated studies. By connecting the heterogeneous stages of computational materials discovery, the LLM-based agents of MAESTRO can operate across application domains and uncover high-performance materials that conventional screening approaches would be unlikely

translated_title: 一种用于端到端计算材料发现的LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 多尺度任务的协调是计算材料发现的有效策略，然而，重复应用多种算法和工具使其具有挑战性。我们报告了MAESTRO，一种大型语言模型（LLM）智能体系统，能够执行金属有机框架（MOFs）的完整筛选流程。它处理大量MOF文献，将相关出版物与其晶体结构关联起来，并将结果整理成可计算数据库，然后通过逐步增加计算成本的策略进行筛选。在湿烟道气条件下分离出的有前景候选材料均来自不相关的研究。通过连接计算材料发现的异构阶段，基于LLM的MAESTRO智能体能够跨应用领域运作，并发现传统筛选方法不太可能发现的高性能材料。
tldr: 本文介绍了MAESTRO，一个基于LLM的智能体系统，能自动化执行MOF材料发现的全流程筛选，通过连接异构任务发现传统方法难以识别的高性能材料。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MAESTRO, an LLM-based agent system that automates the end-to-end screening pipeline for MOF materials discovery, connecting heterogeneous tasks to uncover high-performance materials unlikely found by conventional methods.
